name: Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension / VC Dimension
details: A shattered set projects to a full cube, whose positive recursive teaching dimension equals its dimension.
witness_verification: For every n >= 4, the database-owned values 1129 and 1127 give positive projected RTD n-1 and VC 3. The ratio (n-1)/3 tends to infinity, excluding every reverse affine bound. The former finite witness {001,010,111}, with values 2 versus 1, remains valid and its class/value records are retained. The endpoint proofs and sync/verify_singleton_cosingleton.py cover the stated parameter range.
proof: Let S be shattered with |S|=d. Then $\mathcal H_{|S}$ is the full d-cube and has $\mathrm{RTD}^{+}=d$. Thus $\mathrm{RTD}^{+p}(\mathcal H)\ge d$; maximize over shattered S.
